name: Here Comes The Pride!
source:
Casey (Name Customizable) is a photographer going on vacation to the savannah so he can finally make it big! Unfortunately, an accident occurs where he's separated from the rest of the group and has to be saved by a lion local to the savannah. 

Thankfully for Casey, this lion's a hot daddy wearing nothing but a lioncloth, who decides to take him into his pride. That's where Casey meets the lion's sons, all very attractive in their own way. He then spends time with these lions, soon having the sexiest time of his life.
